subject: History
description: Who-built-what? Mughal, Sultanate, colonial, and modern monuments

questions.stem: The QUTUB MINAR in Delhi was started by Qutb-ud-din Aibak and COMPLETED by:
questions.explanation: Aibak began Qutub Minar in 1199 (first storey only). Iltutmish completed three more storeys. Firoz Shah Tughlaq repaired it after lightning damage and added the fifth storey. UNESCO WHS 1993.
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: The RED FORT (Lal Qila) at Delhi was built by:
questions.explanation: Shah Jahan — built the Red Fort (1639-1648) when he shifted capital from Agra to Shahjahanabad (Delhi). Architect: Ustad Ahmad Lahauri (same as Taj Mahal). The PM hoists the national flag here every Independence Day (15 August).
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: Match the MONUMENT with its BUILDER. A. Agra Fort.  B. Fatehpur Sikri.  C. Buland Darwaza.  D. Moti Masjid (Agra). List-II: 1. Akbar.  2. Akbar.  3. Akbar.  4. Shah Jahan.
questions.explanation: Agra Fort — Akbar (1565-73, brick → red sandstone). Fatehpur Sikri — Akbar (founded as capital 1571). Buland Darwaza — Akbar (1601, commemorating Gujarat conquest). Moti Masjid (Agra) — Shah Jahan (1654). Different answer-labels but same concept match.
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: The GATEWAY OF INDIA (Mumbai) was built to commemorate:

options.option_text: The 1911 visit of King George V and Queen Mary
Founding of the Indian National Congress
Victory in the First World War

questions.explanation: Designed by George Wittet; foundation stone 1911, completed 1924. Indo-Saracenic style. Ironically, the last British troops to leave India (February 1948) sailed off through the Gateway — bookending the colonial era.
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: CHARMINAR in Hyderabad was built in 1591 by:
questions.explanation: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah, 5th sultan of the Qutb Shahi dynasty, built Charminar in 1591 to mark the founding of Hyderabad. Iconic 4-arch minaret structure. Made of granite + limestone.
questions.subject: History

_fixes.was: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah (Qutb Shahi dynasty)

questions.stem: The KONARK SUN TEMPLE was built by:
questions.explanation: Konark Sun Temple (Odisha) — mid-13th century by Narasimhadeva I of Eastern Ganga dynasty. Designed as Sun God's chariot with 12 pairs of wheels and 7 horses. Also called 'Black Pagoda'. UNESCO WHS 1984. Eastern Ganga dynasty, 13th century.
questions.subject: History

questions.stem: NEW DELHI as the planned capital of British India was designed primarily by:
questions.explanation: Edwin Lutyens planned the Rashtrapati Bhavan (then Viceroy's House); Herbert Baker designed the North and South Blocks and Parliament House. Design work 1912 onwards, capital formally inaugurated 1931. (Le Corbusier later designed Chandigarh; Correa designed modern Indian icons like Jawahar Kala Kendra.)
